HERO.NAME: Kacper
HERO.TITLE: I lead a frontend team and build modern web apps with Angular.
HERO.LEAD: I'm a Team Leader and Frontend Developer with nearly 4 years of experience and an MSc in Applied Computer Science from Jagiellonian University. At Comarch I lead a frontend team and develop a time-tracking and reporting system tailored to both small and large companies — pairing agile leadership with an AI-native approach to delivery.
HERO.STATEMENT: I look beyond pure technical execution, combining agile leadership with a strong product and business mindset to deliver solutions that create real value for users and the organization. I'm passionate about AI-Native Development: I scale team-wide use of Claude Code and LLMs in the daily workflow, build autonomous agents for automated code review, and drive AI-assisted testing with MCP and Playwright. My focus is continuous delivery, modernizing scalable frontend architectures, and high-performing collaboration between design, backend, and product.

STACK.TOOLS: GIT (GitLab/GitHub), JIRA, CI/CD, Google Workspace, Figma
STACK.AI_TOOLS: AI Tools: GitHub Copilot, Google Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude Code

COMARCH_CLOUD.HIGHLIGHT_1: Team leadership & agile delivery: I shifted the team from classic Scrum to continuous-flow 'Taxi Teams' on Kanban, and together with Product Management I turn quarterly roadmaps into daily work and coordinate steady delivery.
COMARCH_CLOUD.HIGHLIGHT_2: AI-Native Development: I engineered and scaled team-wide adoption of Claude Code and LLMs, built autonomous agents for automated code review, and set up AI-driven testing with MCP, Playwright, and Claude Code.
COMARCH_CLOUD.HIGHLIGHT_3: Micro-Frontend & Nx Monorepo: I contributed to an internal enterprise admin dashboard built on a micro-frontend architecture with an Nx monorepo.
COMARCH_CLOUD.HIGHLIGHT_4: Large-scale migration Angular 14 → 21: standalone components, zone.js replaced with Signals, and an enforced OnPush change-detection strategy to minimize re-renders.
COMARCH_CLOUD.HIGHLIGHT_5: CI/CD & modernization: I own the frontend technical roadmap — CI/CD pipeline optimization, library upgrades, and architectural refactoring for scalability and clean code.
COMARCH_CLOUD.HIGHLIGHT_6: Cross-functional collaboration: I partner with UX/UI, backend, and QA to translate product requirements into high-performance, user-centric features.

COMARCH_HEALTHCARE.HIGHLIGHT_1: Onboarding to the organization and working with tools: Jira and GitLab.
COMARCH_HEALTHCARE.HIGHLIGHT_2: Development of an internal application module: collecting statistics from the application and presenting them in a view.
COMARCH_HEALTHCARE.HIGHLIGHT_3: Creating charts and clear data visualization (including Chart.js).
COMARCH_HEALTHCARE.HIGHLIGHT_4: Writing unit tests for the statistics module (Jasmine, Karma).
COMARCH_HEALTHCARE.HIGHLIGHT_5: Implementation and maintenance of the application in Angular (Angular 15).
